profiles.name: Hosting affiliate or referral
profiles.description: Refers customers to an upstream provider for a disclosed commission.
not_responsible_for: Infrastructure, accounts, backups or incidents the upstream provider controls

profiles.name: Hosting reseller or white-label
profiles.description: Resells upstream capacity under its own packages and support boundary.
not_responsible_for: Upstream hardware, network and data-center operations

profiles.name: Shared panel hosting
profiles.description: Operates shared servers through a control panel such as cPanel/WHM or Plesk.
responsible_for: Accounts, quotas, DNS, certificates, PHP versions and databases
Backups, restores, isolation and abuse handling

profiles.name: Managed CMS hosting
profiles.description: Runs CMS sites with updates, staging, performance and security managed.
not_responsible_for: Custom feature development unless contracted separately

profiles.name: Developer or application platform
profiles.description: Builds and runs customer applications, including AI-generated ones, with previews and rollback.
responsible_for: Source import, builds, previews and runtime isolation
Secrets, domains, identity, quotas, rollback and exportability

profiles.name: Enterprise and regulated hosting
profiles.description: Dedicated or regulated tenancy with audit evidence, change control and service commitments.
not_responsible_for: Certifying compliance on an auditor's behalf

profiles.name: Web agency
profiles.description: Client engagements from qualified brief to release and support.
responsible_for: Scoped client delivery with acceptance evidence
not_responsible_for: Operating the client's hosting unless a hosting profile is also selected

profiles.name: Extension and SaaS product company
profiles.description: Builds and supports extensions, themes, integrations and SaaS products.
not_responsible_for: Host platform behavior outside the published compatibility range

profiles.name: Developer relations program
profiles.description: Developer research, docs, samples, workshops and feedback into product.

profiles.name: Community and open-source program
profiles.description: Governance, moderation, contribution paths and onboarding for a community.
not_responsible_for: Ranking volunteers or deciding allegations without due process

profiles.name: Public-school BCIT program
profiles.description: Supports a teacher of record with BCIT units, assessments and accessible materials.
responsible_for: Units, materials and assessments for teacher review
Honest standards mapping with gaps shown
not_responsible_for: Grades, student records or acting as teacher of record
